reviews.review:
Genuinely a really fun zombie shooter. No way in hell it deserves the Mixed Rating it currently has. Gameplay is fun, guns feel powerful enough without making my ears bleed (compared to the guns in Left 4 Dead), and the cards spice up the game more than enough in order to give the game plenty of replay value.

The only issue I had with the game is that the difficulty ramps up really f***ing  fast in just a couple of seconds.
No joke, Veteran mode in this kicked my ass way harder than expert ever did to me in Left 4 Dead. You could literally be having a walk in the park shooting zombies here and there, only for the game to suddenly punish you with 3 tall boys and a Hag for no ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ reason.

With that said, I had plenty of fun with this, even if the campaign was a tad bit short.
I really can't recommend the game for 60$ just cuz Left 4 Dead is a waaaay better deal for 10 bucks.
But if you can pick this up on sale for like 6$, then I'd definitely recommend ya to give the game a shot.
Definitely go for the Season Pass as well if you plan on sinking countless hours into this, as it gives you 2 additional campaigns,  really good lookin' cosmetics, and an additional campaign modifier that adds these massive caves where you can ear skull tokens.
It's not left 4 dead, it has different experience, MUST play it with FRIENDS to get full fun experience.
jumping in this game and mindlessly killing zombies with cool gun animations is hella satisfying.

Well, I bought it on a huge sale, and it's probably fine if you think about it as a 2$ game. But at full price? Don't even think about it! Highly monotonous game, very repeatable (same locations 3 times), very unpolished. And very short too! I haven't played Left 4 Dead 2, but it seems like people are right, and this isn't a proper sequel everyone expected.

Play Stardew Valley, or anything else. Don't buy this, please. It doesn't feel good. I'm sorry for people who bought it on release.
This and Black Mesa are another proof that Valve can't count up to three
